ideas.pitch: A quantum optimization pipeline using Qiskit to solve multi-vehicle routing problems with real-time classical feedback loops.
ideas.problem_statement: Quantum Optimization and Real-World Resource Allocation
ideas.title: Q-Route: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Traffic Optimization Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical utility by coupling QAOA (Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm) with a classical heuristic router, hitting the sweet spot of hybrid computing for judges.

ideas.pitch: A QNN-based classifier built with Qiskit Machine Learning to predict molecular binding affinities faster than classical neural networks.
ideas.problem_statement: Quantum Machine Learning Applications in Healthcare
ideas.title: BioQML: Quantum Machine Learning for Drug Discovery Screening
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with QML tracks by applying parametrized quantum circuits (PQCs) to an impactful, easily visualized biomedical dataset.

ideas.pitch: An educational web interface demonstrating BB84 and E91 quantum key distribution protocols with simulated eavesdropping (Eve) and error correction.
ideas.title: QKD-Sim: Quantum Key Distribution Protocol Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Celebrates a decade of cloud quantum computing by providing an intuitive, interactive simulator that helps judges and students grasp cryptographic quantum principles instantly.

ideas.pitch: A hybrid financial portfolio optimization tool leveraging VQE (Variational Quantum Eigensolver) to balance asset returns against market variance.
ideas.title: PortfolioQ: Quantum Portfolio Risk Minimization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies heavy quantum math to a high-value vertical (finance), showcasing deep technical rigor that stands out in a 24-hour hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A distributed network simulation framework using Qiskit primitives to model entanglement swapping and quantum teleportation across a multi-node topology.
ideas.title: EntangleNet: Multi-Node Quantum Teleportation Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on foundational quantum networking protocols, ticking the box for advanced algorithmic implementation requested by Qiskit Fall Fest events.
